info.title: AgentSphere Core API
info.description: Tenant scoped sessions, revocable API keys, queued executions and approval checkpoints. Billing is simulated. API keys may access only their explicit scopes. Poll executions until terminal status or approval pause.

200.description: Successful response. Executions may be queued or paused; poll the execution status.

403.description: Tenant, role, or API-key scope denied

503.description: Dependency unavailable; no fake result is returned
